title: Inka test evidence v1
description: Evidence JSON emitted by a source repository adapter and read by an inka project. Test IDs are opaque to inka and must be unique within a loaded evidence set; the loader rejects duplicates. Executions declare the required set for a test: an entry without an outcome is a declared execution whose result is missing.

provenance.description: Descriptive metadata such as the tested source revision or the capsula run ID. Never used for evaluation; unknown keys are permitted and ignored.

id.description: Opaque test identifier referenced by `test:` in a bind.

body.description: Human-reviewable contract body: the source string of the test, CRLF/LF as produced (the consumer normalizes CRLF to LF before hashing).

executions.description: The declared required execution set. Every entry is required for the test to pass; omitting `outcome` declares an execution whose result is missing. Entry IDs must be unique within a test.
